author: Anton Fefilov
description: A Ruby library for labeled property graphs (ISO GQL model, PG-Schema / PG-Keys) stored in plain PostgreSQL tables, with a visibility policy applied to every node and edge on every hop.

author: Panos Dalitsouris
description: env-agent resolves the external repos a project depends on from per-machine .env.agents files and links them into every worktree, plus a Claude Code agent that sets them up.
